text.p: Schalke of Germany beat Tenerife of Spain 2-0 (halftime 0-0, 1-0 after 90 minutes) after extra time in their UEFA Cup semifinal second leg on Tuesday.

Schalke - 1-Jens Lehmann; 10-Olaf Thon, 25-Johan de Kock, 2-Thomas Linke, 4-Yves Eigenrauch, 20-Jiri Nemec; 6-Andreas Mueller, 8-Ingo Anderbruegge, 19-Mike Bueskens; 3-Radoslav Latal (16-Oliver Held 110), 24-Marc Wilmots.

Tenerife - 13-Beng Andersson; 3-Alexis Suarez, 4-Pablo Paz (19-Dani 59), 12-Sergio Ballesteros, 5-Antonio Mata, 8-Chano Cruzado; 26-Sizwe Motaung, 10-Felipe Minambres, 6-Slavisa Jokanovic; 9-Meho Kodro (15-Oliver Neuville 72), 16-Antonio Pinilla (21-Aurelio Vidmar 98).
